import pytest
from store.cart import Cart, Item
from store.coupons import CouponError


def test_issue_exactly_50_free_shipping():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="Widget", price_cents=5000, qty=1))
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # 5000 >= 5000 -> free (0)


def test_issue_one_cent_below_threshold_charged():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="Widget", price_cents=4999, qty=1))
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 599  # 4999 < 5000 -> flat 599


def test_issue_one_cent_above_threshold_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="Widget", price_cents=5001, qty=1))
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # 5001 >= 5000 -> free (0)


def test_issue_quantities_summing_to_50_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="Widget", price_cents=1250, qty=4))
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # 1250*4=5000 >= 5000 -> free (0)


def test_issue_percent_discount_to_exactly_50_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="Widget", price_cents=10000, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # 10000-5000=5000 >= 5000 -> 0; discount 10000*50//100=5000


def test_issue_fixed_discount_to_exactly_50_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="Widget", price_cents=5500, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # 5500-500=5000 >= 5000 -> 0


def test_issue_empty_cart_no_shipping():
    """An empty cart has no shipping charge."""
    cart = Cart()
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # empty cart -> 0


def test_contract_subtotal_sums_lines():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents * qty over every line in the cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=2))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=250, qty=3))
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 2750  # 1000*2+250*3=2000+750=2750


def test_contract_adding_same_sku_increases_qty():
    """Adding a SKU that is already in the cart increases that line's qty."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=400, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=400, qty=1))
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 2  # 1+1=2


def test_contract_second_coupon_raises():
    """At most one coupon may be applied to a cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=3000, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    with pytest.raises(CouponError):
        cart.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")


def test_contract_percent_coupon_rounded_down():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=99, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 9  # 99*10//100=9 (9.9 floored to 9)


def test_contract_tax_eight_percent_half_up():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=7, qty=1))
    assert cart.tax_cents() == 1  # 7*8/100=56/100=0.56 -> 1


def test_contract_total_sums_components():
    """total = discounted subtotal + shipping + tax, and is never negative."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    assert cart.total_cents() == 1679  # 1000+599+80=1679; tax 1000*8/100=80
